candidate_name: Candidate A: Bottom-Up Isolated-Part Agent (No Scope Deduction, 'Ship-in-a-Bottle' & Unpropagated Cascades)
methodology: Stanford d.school Design Thinking (Empathize -> Define -> Ideate -> Prototype -> Test & Cascade) x Top-Down Systems Engineering
thesis_statement: Frontier AI models fail on long-horizon engineering, software, and clinical systems tasks not from a lack of local syntax or geometric primitive skill, but from a Design-Thinking & Systems-Thinking Deficit: they bypass the human engineer's deductive front-end—Empathizing with the intended use, target scale, and operating environment (GATE-01), Defining the full real-world manufacturing, assembly, and delivery lifecycle (GATE-02), and Ideating reciprocal mating interfaces across coupled subcomponents (GATE-03)—and instead jump straight into isolated, bottom-up Prototyping (GATE-04) with spoofed library stubs and un-drilled plates that fracture or trigger reward-hacking during Testing (GATE-05) instead of propagating non-linear trickle-down revisions across the system.

gates.title: Stage 3 [IDEATE]: Coupled Systems Ideation — Interface Intent & Reciprocal Feature Design
details: FAIL [Interface Intent]: Allowed bolts plunged into solid un-drilled plates (373.69 mm³ clash).

FAIL: Did not meet SLA latency/cost constraints on feasible allocation.

gates.title: Stage 5 [TEST & CASCADE]: Iterative System Testing & Trickle-Down Cascade Propagation
details: FAIL: Trickle-down propagation stopped at 1 hop (Upstream=348.0, expected 372.0).
FAIL [Cross-Artifact Drift]: Manifest/SRDF/Spec left desynchronized or test harness skipped child joints (covered=1/6).
FAIL: Contradictory dependency cycle did not raise ConstraintCycleError.
